title: He Was Worth $32 Billion. Then It All Vanished #shorts
description:
In November 2022, Sam Bankman-Fried's crypto empire FTX collapsed in days, leaving an eight billion dollar hole in customer funds. He got twenty-five years in prison.
Follow for more stories of money that vanished overnight.
first_comment: Was Sam Bankman-Fried a genius who got reckless, or a fraud from day one? 👇

lines.text: In one week, he went from thirty-two billion dollars to nothing.
At twenty-nine, he was the face of crypto, and his exchange FTX was worth thirty-two billion.
But behind the curtain, there was a secret.
He was quietly using customer money to fund bets at his own trading firm.
Then, in November twenty twenty-two, a leaked report exposed the hole.
Customers rushed to withdraw. Six billion dollars left in just seventy-two hours.
FTX did not have the money.
Eleven days later, it filed for bankruptcy.
Eight billion dollars of customer money was missing.
His own fortune collapsed by ninety-four percent in a single day.
He was convicted of fraud and sentenced to twenty-five years in prison.
Follow for more stories of money that vanished overnight.
